name: tidy
tagline_zh: 项目乱成毛线球？一键扫描垃圾文件、临时产物和重复依赖，还能按你的习惯生成清理清单，动手前先给你看，绝不误删。
tagline_en: Tidy your messy repo in one scan: spot junk, temp files, and dup deps. Get a review list first—no accidental.
desc_en: A simple example skill for cleaning up a project.
why_zh: 同类工具只会删，它先列清单让你确认；规则可定制，连.gitignore都帮你补全。
why_en: Unlike blunt cleaners, it previews every deletion, adapts to your rules, and even patches .gitignore.
